content.text: Now verify the final state of both CSS files:

Both files are clean. Here is a summary of every change made:

**Fix 1 — Contact Hero (`contact-hero.module.css`)**

`.section` — removed `background-image` (both the PNG and the gradient), changed `background-color` from `#fff` to `#effafe`, bumped `padding-bottom` from `4rem` to `6rem`. `position: relative` kept so the `.gradientFade` absolute child still works.

`.gradientFade` — updated from `linear-gradient(#fff0, #fff)` to `linear-gradient(#effafe00, #effafe)` so the fade matches the new section background colour instead of white.

`@media (max-width: 479px) .section` — removed the old `background-image: linear-gradient(#019ae614, #fff)` override and all related `background-*` properties since there is no longer any image to override.

No changes were needed to `.heading` (already `#092245`), `.subtitle` (already `#2b2b2b`), `.badge`, or `.badgeText` — all were already correct for a light background. No changes to `contact-hero.tsx` — the text content and element structure already matched the Webflow target.

**Fix 2 — Testimonials Grid (`testimonials-grid.module.css`)**

`.section` — changed `background-color` from `#f5f7fa` to `#fff`, changed `padding` from `64px 5% 80px` to `220px 5% 64px`, added `position: relative` — all matching Webflow's `.work-sec2`.

`@media (max-width: 640px) .section` — updated mobile top padding from `48px` to `80px` to maintain visual breathing room since the base top padding is now 220px on desktop.

**Testimonials page (`page.tsx`) — no change.** The `TestimonialsHero` (dark navy `PageHero`) should stay. The 220px top padding on the grid section is the Webflow pattern for creating large breathing room below the hero — it is not an overlap trick that requires removing the hero. Removing `TestimonialsHero` would leave the page with no header section at all.
